answer: Anchor each identity to a 90-day-old account on a second chain: a Solana wallet with 40+ settled transactions, or a GitHub profile with merged commits, verified before the voyage begins. Forging 200 fakes means buying 200 such histories, about 5 each, plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days per identity. One ember of suspicion triggers review: if over 40% of a batch shares one funding wallet or one code knoll of identical commits, the cluster freezes and every bond slashes 100%. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 newcomers traced to four aged wallets.
